name: opus5-lean-mcp
description: Token-efficiency MCP server for Claude Opus 5. Measures prompt costs, strips wasted tokens, plans cache strategies, and finds cheapest effort levels.

tools.name: opus5_count
tools.description: Count tokens in a prompt and estimate cost. Free (unbilled) with --exact using Anthropic's count_tokens API.

tools.name: opus5_slim
tools.description: Strip wasted tokens from a prompt. Code is never modified. Reports exact savings.

aggressive.description: Also remove typographic characters and HTML comments

tools.name: opus5_cache_plan
tools.description: Plan cache strategy for a prompt. Identifies static vs volatile segments and calculates 80%+ savings.

requests_per_day.description: Expected requests per day for projection

tools.name: opus5_cost_estimate
tools.description: Calculate cost estimate for prompt usage at scale.

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens (per request or total)

output_tokens.description: Total output tokens (per request or total)

use_cache.description: Estimate with cache savings (10x cheaper reads)

tools.name: opus5_sweep
tools.description: Find the cheapest effort level that meets quality requirements. Requires API key with credit.

require.description: Required pattern that must appear in output

trials.description: Number of trials per effort level
